newsitem.title: USA: First Citizens Financial says has approval.
newsitem.headline: First Citizens Financial says has approval.

text.p: First Citizens Financial Corp said Wednesday that its Citizens Savings Bank F.S.B. subsidiary, has recieved all regulatory approvals necessary to complete its proposed purchase of Provident Bankshares Corp. The acuisition now needs the shareholder approval of both companies to become final.

The company said in a statement that both First Citizens and Provident will hold seperate shareholder meetings on Aug 20. The deal is worth roughly $100 million, first Citizens said, adding that the final price will depend upon the price of Provident Bankshares' stock on the closing date of the deal.
